source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Use it in any phase, right after one of your **HEAVY TRANSPORT** units with **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)** is **destroyed**, provided its **Deadly Demise** roll was a 6; that destroyed unit is the target. Before its **Deadly Demise** is resolved, and ahead of any Emergency Disembarkation by units embarked within it, it can make a **Normal move** or a **Fall Back move**. During that move:

- it can cross enemy models that are not **MONSTERS** or **VEHICLES**
- it can come within **Engagement Range** of those models but must end outside it
- every **Desperate Escape test** it takes counts as passed
